name: Plugin Template
description: Starter template for Staffbase custom plugins. Provides session/SSO/GDPR/changelog/settings infrastructure with empty Admin and End User views ready for feature work.
_comment_pluginId: The actual plugin UUID is assigned by the Staffbase platform per environment. Set PLUGIN_ID in the deployment environment.

widgets.title: Plugin Template Widget
widgets.description: Scaffolding widget for a Staffbase custom plugin. Replace the placeholder rendering in widget/src/widget.ts with your plugin-specific UI.
